summary: OCR observe/act must share TTL-bounded cache-dir evidence across CLI processes, retry HID releases after a failed up, and match multi-word Tesseract labels.
reason: The documented observe then act recipe is two process invocations, a canceled mouse-up or key-up can leave the target held, and default TSV word rows cannot match labels such as Save Changes.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/ocr ./internal/semantic covers persisted observation IDs, TSV line phrases, JSON multi-word click-text, and a second HID release after a failed up.
